title: A killed reconciler leaks one gate scratch directory per gate, forever
description:
`startShell` creates a `ticfac-gate-io-*` scratch directory with `os.MkdirTemp`. `gateShell`'s cleanup removes it, but that cleanup is a deferred call, and a SIGKILLed reconciler does not run deferred calls. So every gate a killed reconciler was running leaks one directory, and nothing ever prunes them.

Same class as the worktree registrations that `pruneWorktrees` exists for — the fix is probably the same shape: sweep on start rather than rely on release.

Found by gatecache while doing 6wh, which deliberately did not touch it. The 6wh slot directories themselves are NOT affected: they are a stable, deliberately reused registration, reset on acquire rather than cleaned on release, precisely because release cannot be relied on.
acceptance_criteria: A reconciler that starts after a previous one was killed mid-gate leaves no ticfac-gate-io-* directory behind, proven by a test that kills a reconciler holding one and starts another
